title: Oxidizing a middle alcohol
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: A secondary alcohol is oxidized to a ketone. The oxygen-bearing middle carbon becomes a carbonyl carbon, while its two carbon neighbors remain attached.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of 2-propanol under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: 2-propanol is treated with an oxidizing reagent such as PCC. Which major organic product forms after workup? A secondary alcohol is oxidized to a ketone. The oxygen-bearing middle carbon becomes a carbonyl carbon, while its two carbon neighbors remain attached.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
